snippet.title: My First Playing in Gundam Conquest V (PS Vita)
snippet.description:
Here's my first playing through the game tutorial of another new free-to-play Gundam game on PS Vita.

This game is just a port of Gundam Conquest (iPhone/Android). Besides having "V" on the title, I don't see any differences from what I used to play on my iPhone. 
It has 3 genres, simulation (Based on Giren no Yabou series, I never understand how to play it. -_-), action (I liked this one because it's easy to play.), and creating base things as same as Gundam Battle Fortress (PS Vita).

Well, if you understand Japanese language through lots of menus there, the game might be fun. Still, it's hard to play for foreigners anyway. ^^"
